evidence.quote: This approach to maximum employment has allowed the FOMC to navigate the current recovery in a way that has likely brought more people back into productive employment than might have been the case with a fixed, aggregate unemployment-rate target
This is especially true at a time when the traditional Phillips curve relationship between unemployment and inflation is extremely flat for reasons we do not fully understand.
Even though the unemployment rates of these groups are back around their pre-recession levels, they remain higher than the national average.
At the Federal Reserve, we will continue to navigate the recovery to ensure we reach and sustain our long-term goals of maximum employment and price stability.

parsed.rationale: The speech centers on inclusion and community development, but it implicitly leans dovish by questioning whether aggregate unemployment reflects full employment and by noting a flat Phillips curve. It gives no explicit guidance on the future path of rates or the balance sheet.
